remarks: Lovely space for office/business/medical services in the heart of Wilton town center. Abundant parking. Other tenants include Smile Art Orthodontics and Fresh Green Light Driving School. With its central location, this space would be ideal for businesses catering to kids, teens, and families. Would be great for yoga, tutoring, art, pottery, dance, martial arts, office, or other service related business. Has a wonderful outdoor patio. Floor plan is built out for a chiropractor office and can be modified to suit your needs.
